code_chain.role: main command dispatcher (old FUN_007a2120, 17 KB switch)
gang map loader; reads config/map/<map>.ini, walks 13 building slots
group_frame(group, frame): select active frame per group

payload.absent_type: FUN_0041f2b0(type, 0) hides the whole group and creates a level-0 object at PosTypeN

group_frame.behavior: for each element whose group matches: matching frame => active=1, all other frames of that group => active=0; returns 1 if the group exists

secondary_consumers.behavior: 0x6c-stride table; group at +0x68, visibility written at +0x64
visibility for building objects of type 6 whose +0x78 equals the group

trigger: command 0x3077 only; no timer, loop, or client-side frame advance. Xrefs show 0x426980 <- 0x41f2b0 <- 0x410000 <- 0x7a339c (case 0x3077).
runtime_note: runtime element +0x18 is the active flag written by group_frame, not the file placement flag (file flag: 1=static, 0=group member).
